market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $140 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month is around $104-110/bbl on Apr 30 with intraday high ~$110.90 driven by US-Iran tensions. Hitting $140 would require ~+27% intraday rally during May. Possible only via severe escalation (e.g., Strait of Hormuz disruption), which is not the base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran/Hormuz escalation could cause sharp price spike.
